verses.sanskrit:
कुन्त्युवाच।
              ब्राह्मणं यन्त्रिता राजन्नुपस्थास्यामि पूजया। यथाप्रतिज्ञं राजेन्द्र न च मिथ्या ब्रवीम्यहम्॥१॥
verses.english: Kunti said: "O king of kings, agreeably to your promise, I will, by restraining my senses, wait upon and minister to that Brahmana. I am speaking no falsehood (in this respect).

verses.sanskrit: एष चैव स्वभावो मे पूजयेयं द्विजानिति। तव चैव प्रियं कार्यं श्रेयश्च परमं मम॥२॥
verses.english: To worship the Brahmanas is my habit. And as this is agreeable to you, it will lead to my highest good.

verses.sanskrit: यद्येवैष्यति सायाह्ने यदि प्रातरथो निशि। यद्यर्धरात्रे भगवान्न मे कोपं करिष्यति॥३॥
verses.english: He will never have any cause to be angry with me whether the worshipful one comes in the morning or in the evening or during the night or at midnight.

verses.sanskrit: लाभो ममैष राजेन्द्र यद्वै पूजयती द्विजान्। आदेशे तव तिष्ठन्ती हितं कुर्यां नरोत्तम॥४॥
verses.english: O king of kings, O best of men, it is highly beneficial to me to worship the twice-born ones, to carry out your commands and to do good to you.

verses.sanskrit: विस्रब्धो भव राजेन्द्र न व्यलीकं द्विजोत्तमः। वसन् प्राप्स्यत्ति ते गेहे सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते॥५॥
verses.english: O foremost of kings, rest assured of it. I am telling you truly that the best of Brahmanas dwelling in your house will not in any way be dissatisfied..

verses.sanskrit: यत्प्रियं च द्विजरयास्य हितं चैव तवानघ। यतिष्यामि तथा राजन् व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः॥६॥
verses.english: I will pay (particular) attention to what is agreeable to this Brahmana and to what is beneficial to you. Therefore O king, give up your mental anxiety.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणा हि महाभागाः पूजिताः पृथिवीपते। तारणाय समर्थाः स्युर्विपरीते वधाय च॥७॥
verses.english: The Brahmanas, O lord of the earth, are highly fortunate and when pleased are capable of bestowing salvation. But if displeased, they become (instruments) for destruction.

verses.sanskrit: साऽहमेतद्द्विजानन्ती तोषयिष्ये द्विजोत्तमम्। न मत्कृते व्यथां राजन् प्राप्स्यसि द्विजसत्तमात्॥८॥
verses.english: I, who am well aware of this, will propitiate this foremost of Brahmanas, And O king, you will never, for any act of mine, experience any trouble from that most exalted of Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: अपराधेऽपि राजेन्द्र राज्ञामश्रेयसे द्विजाः। भवन्ति च्यवनो यद्वत् सुकन्यायाः कृते पुरा॥९॥
verses.english: O foremost of kings, owing to the faults of the kings, the twice-born ones become the instruments of their misfortune as formerly Chyavana had become on account of the acts of Sukanya.

verses.sanskrit: नियमेन परेणाहमुपस्थास्ये द्विजोत्तमम्। यथा त्वया नरेन्द्रेदं भाषितं ब्राह्मणं प्रति॥१०॥
verses.english: Agreeably to your instructions with regard to this Brahmana, I will serve him with great regularity, O king of kings."

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवन्तीं बहुशः परिष्वज्य समर्थ्य च। इति चेति च कर्तव्यं राजा सर्वमथादिशत्॥११॥
verses.english: And when she said thus repeatedly, the king encouraged and embraced her and then instructed her minutely as to what she ought to do.

verses.sanskrit:
राजोवाच।
              एवमेतत् त्वया भद्रे कर्तव्यमविशङ्कया। मद्धितार्थं तथाऽऽत्मार्थं कुलार्थं चाप्यनिन्दिते॥१२॥
verses.english: “O gentle and blameless girl, you will act in this way, without any fear, for my welfare, for your good and for the welfare of the race."

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु तां कन्यां कुन्तिभोजो महायशाः। पृथां परिददौ तस्मै द्विजाय द्विजवत्सलः॥१३॥
verses.english: The King said : Saying this, the highly-renowned Kuntibhoja, devoted to the Brahmanas, made over his daughter Pritha to that twice-born one.

verses.sanskrit: इयं ब्रह्मन् मम सुता बाला सुखविवर्धिता। अपराध्येत यत् किञ्चिन्न कार्यं हृदि तत् त्वया॥१४॥
verses.english: (Saying), “O Brahmana, this is my daughter (Pritha) of tender years and reared in luxury. If she commits any fault, do not mind it.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजातयो महाभागा वृद्धबालतपस्विषु। भवन्त्यक्रोधनाः प्रायो ह्यपराद्धेषु नित्यदा॥१५॥
verses.english: The highly renowned Brahmanas do not get angry with old men, ascetics and children, even if they repeatedly offend them.

verses.sanskrit: सुमहत्यपराधेऽपि क्षान्तिः कार्या द्विजातिभिः। यथाशक्ति यथोत्साहं पूजा ग्राह्या द्विजोत्तम॥१६॥
verses.english: The twice-born ones again ought to pardon even a very serious offence; and the best of Brahmanas should accept that worship which is offered to the best of one's ability and exertion.

verses.sanskrit: तथेति ब्राह्मणेनोक्त स राजा प्रीतमानसः। हंसचन्द्रांशुसङ्काशं गृहमस्मै न्यवेदयत्॥१७॥
verses.english: And that Brahmana having said “be it so," the king with a merry mind placed at his disposal a suite of apartments white as the swan or the ray of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राग्निशरणे क्लृप्तमासनं तस्य भानुमत्। आहारादि च सर्वं तत् तथैव प्रत्यवेदयत्॥१८॥
verses.english: And in the fire-room the king placed a resplendent seat especially made for him and also all sorts of food and other articles of the same good quality.

verses.sanskrit: निक्षिप्य राजपुत्री तु तर्न्द्रा मानं तथैव च। आतस्थे परमं यत्नं ब्राह्मणस्याभिराधने॥१९॥
verses.english: And driving away her idleness and pride, the princess began to exert herself with the utmost care for the service of the Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सा ब्राह्मणं गत्वा पृथा शौचपरा सती। विधिवत् परिचारार्हं देववत् पर्यतोषयत्॥२०॥
verses.english: And going to the Brahmana there in the fire-room) the chaste Pritha, observant of purity, duly ministering to him as if he were a god, pleased him highly.
